lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are organized into roughly parallel vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. A primary column of three spots is located above the pectoral fin insertion, with at least five subsequent columns extending posteriorly in a semi-regular grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of spots, forming a visible grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is situated along the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Four remoras are visible: one positioned between the gill slits and the pectoral fin, and three attached to the trailing and distal margins of the pectoral fin.
